questions.stem: For whom are Canned Reports built?
options: Tech-savvy users who know how to use BI tools
Non-tech-savvy stakeholders who want to click once and see the expected output
questions.explanation: Canned Reports are static, pre-designed reports for non-tech-savvy stakeholders who just want to click once and see the required output.

questions.stem: What characterises an Ad hoc Report?
options: It is static and designed once by developers
It is generated automatically every night
Users build their own reports and dashboards by dragging and dropping exposed tables and columns
It is only available as a PDF
questions.explanation: Ad hoc reporting lets tech-savvy users build their own reports and dashboards by drag and drop, slicing, dicing and drilling.

questions.stem: What two kinds of knowledge do Ad hoc Report users need?
options: Knowledge of the BI tool and business knowledge of the data elements shared in it
questions.explanation: Ad hoc reports are for tech-savvy users who know how to use the BI tools and who also have business knowledge of the data elements exposed.

questions.stem: Which capabilities are available to users of Ad hoc Reports?
options: Slice and dice, drill-in and drill-out
questions.explanation: With ad hoc reporting users can slice and dice reports and drill in and out.

questions.stem: Which tools are considered Canned Report generators?
questions.explanation: Oracle Forms and SSRS are given as examples of Canned Report generators.

questions.stem: Which tools are considered Ad hoc Report generators?
questions.explanation: Tableau, Power BI and Qlik are considered Ad hoc Report generators.

questions.stem: How are OBIEE and Cognos classified?
options: Semi-canned and semi-ad hoc report generators
questions.explanation: OBIEE and Cognos are considered semi-canned and semi-ad hoc report generators.

questions.stem: Canned Reports follow the same approach as which related concept?
questions.explanation: Just like Canned Data, Canned Reports take the same approach: static, pre-designed output available at one click.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Ad hoc Reports?
options: Being static and designed once for a single click
Dragging and dropping tables and columns
questions.explanation: Being static and designed for a single click is the hallmark of Canned Reports; ad hoc reports are built interactively by the user.

questions.stem: Which tool would you choose to give a non-technical manager a fixed report that runs at one click?
questions.explanation: SSRS, along with Oracle Forms, is classed as a Canned Report generator, suited to static one-click reports for non-tech-savvy stakeholders.
